text: Jersey is a self-governing** island territory** in the Channel Islands, located off France’s northwestern coast. It is a British Crown Dependency, so for country streaks purposes it is counted as part of the United Kingdom.
text_zh: 澤西島是海峽群島中的一個自治**島嶼領地**，位於法國西北海岸外。它是英國王室屬地，所以在連勝挑戰中被視為英國的一部分。

text: The island is shaped by a unique mix of British and Norman influences. The many **winding roads** and hedgerows are reminiscent of English country lanes, with **tree-covered** roads being particularly common. However, due to Jersey’s unique geographical position, most coverage features **sunny **weather.
All images were taken by a **Generation 2** camera.
text_zh: 這座島嶼的特色融合了獨特的英國與諾曼第影響。許多**蜿蜒道路**和綠籬讓人聯想到英國鄉間小路，其中**樹木覆蓋**的道路特別常見。不過，由於澤西島獨特的地理位置，大部分的街景都有著**晴朗**的天氣。
所有影像皆由**第二代**相機拍攝。

text: Jersey licence plates follow the British model, having a long **white front** and **yellow rear** plate. In addition, you will notice the island’s red coat of arms on the left, as well as the letter ‘J’ at the beginning of all codes in unblurred plates.
NOTE: In contrast to the British mainland, Jersey was never a member of the European Union. This means that local plates do not have a blue strip.
text_zh: 澤西島車牌遵循英國模式，具有長條形的**白色前車牌**和**黃色後車牌**。此外，你會注意到左側有該島的紅色徽章，且在清晰未模糊的車牌上，所有代碼開頭都有一個「J」字。
註：與英國本土不同，澤西島從未加入歐盟。這意味著當地車牌沒有藍色邊條。

text: In general, road infrastructure is **similar **to that found in the United Kingdom. This includes driving on the [left](https://goo.gl/maps/fcPxAUuyzEzRf9Ak7), as well as [directional signs](https://goo.gl/maps/kNsowiMi9Dd68QKt5), [chevrons](https://goo.gl/maps/NBkNUYfGXL1baFQr8) and [warning signs](https://goo.gl/maps/dK5pbVjsHtbSjTAo6). Some of the subtle differences are discussed below.
text_zh: 一般來說，道路基礎設施與英國發現的**相似**。這包括靠[左](https://goo.gl/maps/fcPxAUuyzEzRf9Ak7)行駛，以及[方向標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/kNsowiMi9Dd68QKt5)、[轉彎標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/NBkNUYfGXL1baFQr8)與[警告標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/dK5pbVjsHtbSjTAo6)。以下將討論一些細微的差異。

text: Due to its proximity to France, the vast majority of street and locality names contain **French **words. The island’s traditional language, known as [Jèrriais](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais), is closely related to French and appears on some [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/gfXPVEU3CehwnLD79).
text_zh: 由於鄰近法國，絕大多數的街道和地名都包含**法文**單字。該島的傳統語言被稱為[澤西語](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J%C3%A8rriais)，與法語密切相關，並出現在一些[路標](https://goo.gl/maps/gfXPVEU3CehwnLD79)上。

text: Similarly, the local **architecture **shares many characteristics with that of northern France. This includes pastel-coloured walls and dark slate roofs. However, [British-style](https://goo.gl/maps/j6uEGrojSRmpRXPS8) terraced houses are also common.
text_zh: 同樣地，當地的**建築**與法國北部有許多共同特徵。這包括粉彩色的牆壁和深色石板屋頂。不過，[英式風格](https://goo.gl/maps/j6uEGrojSRmpRXPS8)的連棟房屋也很常見。

text: Jersey is home to large reserves of **red granite**. As a result, it is a popular building material used for the construction of many **walls **and houses throughout the island.
text_zh: 澤西島擁有大量的**紅色花崗岩**儲量。因此，它是島上許多**牆壁**和房屋建設常用的熱門建築材料。

text: In contrast to the iconic red booths found on the mainland of the UK,** telephone booths** in Jersey are uniquely yellow.
text_zh: 與英國本土標誌性的紅色電話亭不同，澤西島的**電話亭**是獨特的黃色。

text: **Cornish palms** (Cordyline australis) can be identified by their distinctive thin trunks and arching leaves. They are commonly used as decorative plants on Jersey.
NOTE: These palms can also be found on some stretches of the British mainland’s coastline.
text_zh: **康沃爾棕櫚**（Cordyline australis）以其特有的細樹幹和拱形葉子為特徵。它們在澤西島上常用作裝飾植物。
註：這些棕櫚樹也可以在英國本土的一些海岸線沿線找到。

text: Jersey uses **yellow give-way lines** at intersections.
NOTE: In contrast, the UK typically uses double dotted [white lines](https://goo.gl/maps/bKPN9mD7NQVUyoUi9) for this purpose.
text_zh: 澤西島在路口使用**黃色讓路線**。
註：相對地，英國通常使用雙虛線[道路標線](https://goo.gl/maps/bKPN9mD7NQVUyoUi9)來達到此目的。

text: Jersey has an extensive network of cycling routes. Most notably, you will find [signs](https://goo.gl/maps/i9MW5htcqMZYhqRq9) referencing the start or end of a **“Green Lane”**. Blue [**route markers**](https://goo.gl/maps/kqz88wFjRsujGHFx5), containing a map of the island in the centre, are also common.
text_zh: 澤西島擁有廣泛的自行車道網路。最值得注意的是，你會找到提及**「綠色通道」**起點或終點的[標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/i9MW5htcqMZYhqRq9)。中心印有該島地圖的藍色[**路線標記**](https://goo.gl/maps/kqz88wFjRsujGHFx5)也很常見。

text: Some road signs are **asymmetrically **attached to their signposts. This appears to be more prevalent on Jersey than on the British mainland.
NOTE: Keep in mind that this only applies to a minority of signs. Most are attached regularly.
text_zh: 有些道路標誌是**非對稱地**固定在支柱上。這在澤西島似乎比在英國本土更為普遍。
註：請記住，這僅適用於少數標誌。大多數都是正常安裝的。

text: Most street name signs in Jersey are adorned with the **coat of arms** of the parish in which they are located.
_You can click on the graphic to enlarge it._
text_zh: 澤西島的大多數路名標誌都裝飾有所屬教區的**紋章**。
_你可以點擊圖片將其放大。_

text: Contrasting with the island’s typically rural look, the area surrounding the capital city of** St Helier** is more urbanised, featuring taller buildings, narrower streets and a more lively atmosphere.
text_zh: 與該島典型的鄉村風貌形成對比，首都**聖赫利爾**周邊地區更加都市化，擁有更高的建築、更窄的街道和更熱鬧的氣氛。

text: The Les Mielles Nature Reserve is a vast, **treeless **expanse located on Jersey’s western coast. Combined with the gentle westward slope and partially overcast coverage, this makes for a very recognisable area.
text_zh: 萊米爾自然保護區（Les Mielles Nature Reserve）是位於澤西島西海岸的一片廣闊、**無樹**的開闊地帶。結合了平緩的向西坡度以及部分陰天的街景，這使得該地區極具辨識度。

text: Imagery containing a greenish-purple **discolouration **can be found in the southwest of the island.

NOTE: This glitch typically makes parts of the screen appear darker than they actually are. In addition, it blends into the landscape more seamlessly than [other glitches](https://goo.gl/maps/4B8quhU7FXLricWn7).
Moreover, this glitch is not unique to Jersey. It can be found in other countries as well.
text_zh: 島嶼西南部可以找到帶有綠紫色**變色**的影像。
註：這種瑕疵通常會使螢幕的一部分看起來比實際更暗。此外，它比[其他瑕疵](https://goo.gl/maps/4B8quhU7FXLricWn7)更能無縫地融入風景中。
而且，這種瑕疵並非澤西島獨有。它也可以在其他國家找到。

text: The roads surrounding **Jersey Airport** can be recognized thanks to the visible boundary **fence**.
text_zh: **澤西機場**周圍的道路可以透過清晰可見的邊界**圍籬**來辨識。

text: The La Collette Power Station is located on a peninsula south of the capital. Its **chimney **can be seen from various points along the south coast and serves as a useful reference point for pinpointing.
text_zh: 拉科萊特發電廠（La Collette Power Station）位於首都南部的半島上。它的**煙囪**可以從南海岸的各個點看到，是精確定位時很有用的參考點。

text: **Victoria Ave** runs along the island’s southern coast, immediately west of St Helier. It is the only **divided **road on Jersey and features a distinct maroon median.
text_zh: **維多利亞大道**（Victoria Ave）沿着島嶼南海岸運行，就在聖赫利爾的正西方。它是澤西島上唯一的**分隔**道路，並具有明顯的栗色中央分隔帶。
